evidence.text: Gross profit for 2019 increased $267.6 million, or 12.0%, to $2,491.1 million from $2,223.5 million for 2018. Gross profit, as a percentage of sales, or gross margin, decreased slightly to 47.7% in 2019 from 47.9% for 2018. Our domestic wholesale segment gross profit decreased $10.4 million, or 2.2%, to $457.9 million for 2019 from $468.3 million for 2018, which was primarily attributable due to lower sales. Domestic wholesale gross margins decreased to 36.7% for 2019 from 37.2% for 2018 primarily due to increased tariffs.
